svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three rows. On the left of each, a small circle holds the two marker arrows: grey r_L lying flat and amber r_R at angle α to it; on the right, the distribution of hits on the screen. Row one, “no marker”: α = 0, the arrows coincide and the screen shows cyan fringes at full contrast. Row two, “path marker”: α = 90°, the arrows are perpendicular, the magenta vertical is the distinguishability D = 1, and the screen shows a single bump without fringes. Row three, “erased marker”: the arrows are still perpendicular but the marker is read along the violet diagonal; sorting the hits by that reading gives two rows, cyan fringes and dashed anti-fringes shifted by half a fringe, which add up to the bump of row two. The envelope is schematic.
